craft_notes: Sthāyin: He-I climax (so'ham — the =B9haṃ bytes kept; the text's identity core). Sanskrit: yadā mamecchā notpannā...tattvato =B9haṃ tathābhūtas → L4 keeps the conditional structure: unrisen desire → then I am → truly He-I. Rows: row 2 (then-I-am→He-I). Close: that-minded (tanmanā — the knowing-mind as RESULT, not method). Rejected: 'awareness is all' — killed: He-I kept (the personal formula IS the verse); 'when desires cease' softened — killed: unrisen kept (notpanna — never arose, or unrisen-moment).

lines: When my desire unarisen, knowing, or why —
then I am: truly He-I, dissolved, that-minded.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yadā mamecchā notpannā jñānaṃ vā kas tadāsmi vai | tattvato =B9haṃ tathābhūtas tallīnas tanmanā bhavet

reads_against.argmap: Who am I without desire? → Unrisen desire reveals He-I — dissolved, that-minded.
c1_essence: Desire unarisen: truly He-I, dissolved, that-minded.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta tipping into śānta (wonder at identity unmade)
